class.name: SteamAudioPlayer
class.brief_description: This player's transform is used as the audio source transform in the SteamAudio simulation.

method.name: play_stream
method.description: Plays the given stream starting at from_offset, at the defined volume and pitch scale. [b]A very important note[/b]: play_stream is what you want to use if you'd like to change a SteamAudioPlayer's stream at runtime. Do not try to set the player's stream directly through set_stream, as that will disable all SteamAudio effects for that player. At runtime, the stream you've configured will be replaced with a [SteamAudioStream]. This stream has an inner stream which corresponds to what you configured in the scene.

members.member: Whether SteamAudio distance attenuation is enabled. Keep in mind that this is disabled by default, and enabling it will disable Godot's built-in attenuation, which you can only re-enable when you disable this.

Opt in to listener-centric baked reverb from [SteamAudioProbeVolume] when [member reflection] is enabled. This is a room response at the listener, not source-to-listener reflections. By default reflections remain real-time, even when baked data is loaded. The baked wet send uses the source's Steam Audio distance attenuation when enabled; otherwise Godot's attenuation applies to the final mix. Real-time reflections are not attenuated again in the wet send. Falls back to real-time when a visible reflection-bearing probe neighborhood cannot be guaranteed. Overlapping path-only batches and missing probe metadata prevent baked selection. Steam Audio selects at most eight influencing probes per batch before ray occlusion; batches exceeding that limit cannot establish a valid neighborhood here. Probe visibility uses the committed Steam Audio scene, including dynamic geometry.
The maximum distance from the listener at which reflection simulation and its wet mix are enabled for this audio source.

See [url=https://valvesoftware.github.io/steam-audio/doc/capi/simulation.html#_CPPv4N27IPLDistanceAttenuationModel11minDistanceE]IPLDistanceAttenuationModel.minDistance[/url], and note the distance attenuation type in godot-steam-audio is always [code]IPL_DISTANCEATTENUATIONTYPE_INVERSEDISTANCE[/code].

Enable baked pathing (sound around corners via [SteamAudioProbeVolume]). Requires baked pathing data in the scene. For occluded sources, pathing is muted when a visible source/listener probe neighborhood cannot be established, including missing probe metadata or more than eight influencing probes per batch. This avoids replaying stale SDK path coefficients.
If validation is on and a baked path is blocked by dynamic geometry, search for an alternate path.
Gain applied to the pathing wet mix.
Ambisonic order used to spatialize pathing, clamped to the simulator's allocated maximum. Audio uses the order of the completed simulation, not a setting changed while that simulation was running.
Re-test baked paths against dynamic geometry (doors, movers).
Whether SteamAudio occlusion and transmission is enabled.
